methods.name: 3D environmental response surfaces
methods.sensor_scope: MQ families listed in MQInfo.py; only 8 installed on Tank
methods.required_validation: Numerical equivalence of source method, known correction domain and matched R0/heater meaning, then grouped calibration dataset

methods.name: 4D time/temperature/RH sensor trajectory visualization and prediction
methods.required_validation: Must retain time-group holdout and measured-vs-predicted differentiation; no 4D observation from single instant snapshot

methods.name: Forecast/regression model workbench, not 76 gas identification experts
methods.sensor_scope: supported source models, training data required
inputs: feature T RH and optionally time
methods.required_validation: Compare with simple baseline under grouped or temporal holdout, no leakage, report abstention outside training domain

invariants: Keep food freshness task separate from gas identity
No 3D/4D generated surfaces count as independent physical evidence
No synthetic or extrapolated environmental surfaces promoted to Stable without separate tested input
